reviews.title: Keep it simple
reviews.text: Bought a Centr treadmill and I just want to keep track of data on my phone. Such a simple demand can’t be accomplished on this app! It just want everyone to sign up online gym membership. Waste of time.

reviews.title: New app sucks
reviews.text:
I HATE the new app. I still love the workouts, but the app makes me so mad- it overrides my Apple Watch fitness app, turning it off in favor of the Centr app. If that’s how I wanted to track my workouts, I would. But it’s not. I want a desktop/web version- I don’t like having to look at such a tiny screen. 

I also feel like the company is
Moving away from their original goals/purpose into making money selling equipment. 

Ugh!!!

reviews.title: Custom Music Playback No Longer Possible.
reviews.text: With the latest update I can no longer play a custom Spotify playlist while following the training programs on my phone.  I need 2 separate devices to accomplish this now.

reviews.title: Super buggy app
reviews.text: Supper buggy app, constant glitches, poor performance and overall frustrating experience. Definitely needs major improvements

reviews.title: Bad App
reviews.text: Terrible App. Programs offered with equipment not chosen. A of bugs. Avoid this.

reviews.title: Getting Bored
reviews.text: Everything's just Hyrox focused now. App works ok, most of the time. No new programs unless you're training for Hyrox. Older programs ignored and buggy (and they refuse to use the right type of music for some)

reviews.title: Very bad design
reviews.text: The workouts were slow, poorly paced, and the weird thing they do with music getting much quieter every time someone talked made it feel very awkward. Music doesn’t turn down when you are working out in a gym. It ruins the energy, takes you out of the zone. That the product and design team made this unrealistic, strange choice is reflective of their much worse decisions in the app experience. Searching for workouts, filtering, are all very difficult and non-intuitive. They are either really bad at it or trying to reinvent something that has been perfected by 95% of apps and doesn’t need to be reinvented. Finally, don’t try to cancel. You can’t cxl on the app. Unless you sign up with your Shop account (which isn’t an option on the app), you can’t cxl on the desktop either unless you follow a bizarrely convoluted path to find a backend trick to get into your app account. It is easy to write me off because here I am leaving a 1 star review, maybe I am just disgruntled, but it is likely Centr is violating US law. FCC stipulates very clearly that it should as easy to cxl as to sign up. It is hard to, even with the most gracious of interpretations, say that their cxl process is as remotely close to as easy as sign up. I felt tricked and deceived.

reviews.title: Its glitchy
reviews.text: There is no explanation on the elevation of seats. If you get a call the app blows V up and nothing recorded. It’s not worth 30 per month

reviews.title: Used to be good. Now super buggy
reviews.text: I love the app and its workouts. But the last few months it’s been buggy as hell.  Sometimes I can’t even log on when I am at the gym to do the workout.  Please level up here or else you will lose me.

reviews.title: Trash App
reviews.text: I could not even use the app. I attempted to sign up for a free trial. It never let me finish the set up, or so I thought. When I attempted to log in, it would take me to the app and ask me to create an account . I would create the account, but it wouldn't save it so I could log in. I'd go back to the website and try and sign up, it wouldn't save repeat over and over. I gave up, clearly its been poorly developed. A week later I was charged $80. Support has not got back to me and my bank denied my claim. Glad I am out $80 for an app that doesn't even work.

reviews.title: Update this app!
reviews.text: The workouts are good when the app works. And whoever is directing the trainers, key on the words that they use over and over. “That’s a little gangster!” Enough ! Just get the app to work! App doesn’t work yet again! If I could give less than one star…

reviews.title: Need to sort this app out urgently
reviews.text: Do you know what’s annoying when you’re right in the middle of a workout? The video freezing - to compound matters the scroller doesn’t work within the app, so if it does freeze and you need to refresh you’ll spend the time trying to hit forward 10 seconds multiple times in order to try and reach where you were before. This is basic stuff - fix it.

reviews.title: Login and safing buggy
reviews.text: Reoccuring login issues or trainings session are not saved even after multiple attemps. Very annoying.

reviews.title: Try to cancel
reviews.text: Worst support I’ve ever seen. Makes it impossible to cancel a a subscription

reviews.title: It’s a trap
reviews.text: It won’t let you cancel your subscription. I keep trying to log in and it’ll switch me to the app. I’ll go back to the browser and it won’t load. So they get you by not letting you leave.

reviews.title: App function
reviews.text: The app is always unreliable and sometimes doesn’t open on my phone or iPad. It’s been really frustrating considering how much they charge.

reviews.title: Won't open
reviews.text:
So frustrating, the app opens sometimes and others won't. Usually I can get it to work but it was been 3 days and I can't get it to open. I was able to access my account in safari to complete my grocery list and recipes but I want to work out now and the app won't open. 
Safari is not the best platformorm to follow the workout plan. Help

reviews.title: Offline for 48 hours
reviews.text: The app has been offline and unable to load for the last two days. £22 a month for a bricked app? No thanks.

reviews.title: Non stop log in issues
reviews.text: I like the app itself but at least once a week I can’t get into it for the whole day. User support take about three days to get back and never actually help. Hugely frustrating and has gotten a lot worse with recent updates.

reviews.title: Good app but unreliable service
reviews.text: Your app is constantly down. The customer service person should do a better job at letting ppl know if/why the app is down or at least that you guys are looking into it. I’ll be moving to a different service when my subscription is over.

reviews.text:
This has been going on for several days. It asks me to log in and it says

“We’re sorry your request was malformed…” and then shows code

reviews.title: Not worth the money
reviews.text: This app glitches a lot.  It is difficult to navigate particularly when it comes to searching for specific workouts.  I had a lot of hopes about this and while it has helped me get started in my fitness journey I can’t say I recommend this. There are other apps build as a one stop shop for you to track weight, calories, etc., and this is not the app.  Not to mention my membership hasn’t even expired and I cannot even log in.

reviews.title: Hard to Cancel
reviews.text: The website says you have to cancel in the app, and the app says you have cancel on the web.  After you cancel, they will sneak in a subscription charge on your card a year or two later.

reviews.title: Can’t login
reviews.text: I can’t login with my account, this is making me waste time before starting my workout. I will stop the  annual subscription which should renew next week, I can’t get frustrated each time I start a workout, the purpose of this should be to relax me.

reviews.title: I wish I never downloaded this app
reviews.text: They continue to charge my card even though I didn’t sign up for the membership!!

reviews.title: Ripoff
reviews.text: I just bought an inspire/Center brand multi gym that supposedly came with a free one year subscription of this app. When registering with the app and signing up for the subscription, there is no way to Apply the coupon code for the free annual subscription. When you dig down into the profile settings and try to apply the coupon, you get an error message saying you are already an activated member and the coupon doesn’t apply. I don’t know if it is a scam or if just an incompetent and seemingly impossible process to use the supposed free annual membership. This is not a review of the app itself, because as soon as I discovered that I could not use the coupon, I immediately deactivated my one week free trial so I wouldn’t be charged the rather exorbitant cost for the annual membership and then deleted my account. I will not be using this app. I will look elsewhere to figure out what I can do with my Center branded multi gym. The other thing I didn’t notice before deleting my subscription and account was that the app itself is in no way directly tied to any of the equipment I bought from the same company that makes the app, which seems like a massive oversight.

reviews.title: So disappointed
reviews.text:
I started using Centr in December 2019, just before Covid kicked in. The app helped me to get through Covid and I absolutely loved it.
However, now I find myself greatly disappointed with it.  Before Christmas I had no menu planning for a week, the new programs being offered only cater for intermediate level and above, I find the app often doesn’t load and as far as I can see there have been no new recipes for a good couple of months. 
Centr used to be fun - there was almost a family atmosphere - now the trainers are all American and boring.
My subscription comes up for renewal really soon and I’m no longer sure I’ll be renewing. So disappointed!!

reviews.title: Too Expensive
reviews.text: $30 a month subscription is way too much for a fitness app.

reviews.title: I’m tired of this
reviews.text: Wants you to sign up before even telling you prices, the last thing I want is get an extra Email a day to my 22,000 unread email.   What if I don’t like the prices?

reviews.title: Shady financial accessibility
reviews.text: Horrible app. Non existent access to pay history of payment or past subscription status.

reviews.title: A total rip off
reviews.text: The exercises are decent, but you are required to have a gym membership to perform most of them or purchase equipment through them. Even though during the set up process, they ask what kind of equipment is available to the user, from which it was clearly stated that I only have a few weights at home, resistance band, and a yoga mat, the exercises they provided require gym equipment. not for me for sure.

reviews.title: Not what is promised
reviews.text: I selected no gym, body weight only. Subscribed for the free 1 week trial and there are zero options for body weight only. Every single workout says “gym equipment.” Beware - if you don’t have gym equipment, this is not for you.

reviews.title: Will cancel membership
reviews.text: I’ve been a member for a very long time. This app used to be great. Workouts were great, had meal plans, the trainers were engaged with the community, new programs were released with excitement, etc. No longer. After it was sold, the app has steadily declined. They have constant bugs, they are horrible with replying, they just throw programs together using cut and paste it seems, there are no coached workouts anymore, meal plans have not been updated in who knows how long, and they spend all their time trying to sell their equipment. The community no longer knows what trainers are around. This was such a great product, now it’s absolutely horrible and not worth the frustration or money. It’s sad to say.

reviews.title: Worst customer service
reviews.text: Signed up for free trial, app has glitches, turns out app has no option to cancel. Wasn’t able to sign in to their website, contacted their customer service which is not accepting calls only emails, some guy named Alex from sales showed some decency to had tech support email me. They told me I had signed up with Google and had to cancel through Google. I told them I  signed up through Apple, then they sent me generic how to cancel transaction with Apple.  I wanted to cancel my free trail.  No one even took a second to figure out why I wasn’t able to log into their website which is conveniently only place you have option to cancel when I had no issue logging in to their app.  They had no issue charging my card week after even though I requested cancellation multiple times via email. Now I have to dispute the transaction and wait for my money to be refunded.

reviews.title: Centr
reviews.text: App never works. Don’t honor trial period. Get anything else instead

reviews.title: Cancellation Impossible
reviews.text:
I have tried MANY times and am still getting billed!!!😡
No stars!

reviews.title: Most recent update broke app
reviews.text: I’m no longer able to log in. It just constantly brings me back to the log in page when I put in my credentials.

reviews.title: Good Luck Figuring This Out
reviews.text: I have been hoping to get this app for several months and I finally have the money to do it. The Apple App Store says it should be $89.99 for the Black Friday deal, but once you download the app, you’re re-directed to the website to sign up, where the price is $134.99. I attempted to sign up via Apple but I’m stuck in a circle: my masked email address has already been assigned an account, but I never set up a password. I attempted to utilize “forgot password” but I never receive an email to reset it. I gave up and just put in my actual email address, but it defaults to the sign up page every time I input a password. Now I have some email verification code in my inbox, but no email verification form to input it to. I’ve spent 45 minutes trying to pay Centr and can’t figure it out. What a mess!!
